title: HyperAgents:按分数与子代数采样父代
source_commit: local methods_src/hyperagents checkout; git commit unavailable
note: 移植的是它的父代选择:以前三名均值为中心的 sigmoid,再乘 exp(-(子代数/8)^3)。顺带记下一条查证过的差异:它另一个选择器 select_next_parent 算完子代数和分数后把它们整个丢掉,直接 random.choice —— 均匀的是那个分支,不是公式本身(归一化的 sigmoid 并不均匀)。区别在于「设计上就随机」还是「两个选择器里有一个忽略了自己算出来的统计量」。

deviations.what: No real archive: one candidate per round.
deviations.why: The port records what the archive rule would have done rather than pretending it ran one.

deviations.what: Staged-eval rescaling, the agent/ensemble element-wise max and the multi-domain average have no counterpart.
deviations.why: The platform's score is already a full-set measurement; applying a discount would invent an advantage the platform did not grant.

deviations.what: Which of the two selectors ran is fixed by `HG_HYPERAGENTS_SELECT`.
deviations.why: HyperAgents ships two selectors whose defaults disagree; the one used is recorded on every point.
